title: Audio/Visual Repair and Replacement
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC NORFOLK.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR NORFOLK
description_text: Recruit Training Command (RTC) located in Great Lakes, Illinois, requires an urgent, firm-fixed-price (FFP) procurement of commercial audio-visual (AV) equipment, system integration, and technical repair services to remediate extensive storm damage sustained to the Midway Ceremonial Drill Hall AV system. This system is an essential asset directly tied to the broadcasting and live-streaming infrastructure required to support RTC graduation ceremonies executed every Thursday. Please see the attached solicitation which includes further details within the statement of work concerning the requirement.
